questions.question: In an election between two candidates, a candidate who gets 72% of the votes is elected with a majority of 572 votes. Find the total number of votes polled. (assuming all votes are valid)
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

The winning candidate gets the majority of votes = 572

Winning candidate got % of votes = 72 

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume that 100% of votes are polled

Since, the winning candidate gets = 72% votes of polled votes

Hence, the other candidate gets = 28% votes of the polled votes.

⇒ Difference = (72 - 28) = 44% of polled votes.

Now, According to the question winning candidate got the majority of votes = 572.

⇒ 44% of polled votes = 572

⇒ 100% polled votes = 572over 44 × 100 = 1300.

**Hence, the number of votes polled = 1300.**

questions.question: If we want ₹8,640 three years from now and the compounded interest rate is 20% p.a how much should we invest today? (assuming interest is compounded yearly)
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Amount at the end of 3 years = Rs8,640.

Rate = 20%

Time = 3 years.

**FORMULA USED: **

 

Amount = P × ( 1 +R/100)^t Where P = Principal, R = Rate of interest, t = time.

**CALCULATION:**

Amount = Rs8,640 , R = 20% Time = 3 years

 Amount = P × ( 1+ R/100)^t 

⇒ 8640 = P × ( 1+20/100)³ 

⇒ 8640 = P × 6/5 × 6/5 × 6/5 

⇒ P = Rs5,000.

**Hence, at present investment should be Rs5,000.**

questions.question: A man offers a 21% discount on an item. He offers a further discount of 40% on the reduced price for the first 100 customers. If the selling price of the item is ₹4,740, and the customer is one of the first 100 then what is the marked price (in ₹) of the item?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:****

Selling price = Rs4,740.

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = ( 1-d₁/100) × ( 1-d₂/100) × M.P. 

 

Where S.P. = Selling price,

M.P. = Marked price,

d₁and d₂ = successive discounts respectively.

**CALCULATION:**

Here, S.P. = Rs4,740.,d₁ = 21% , d₂ = 40%

⇒ S.P. = ( 1-d1/100) × ( 1-d2/100) × M.P. 

⇒ 4,740 = ( 1- 21/100) × ( 1-40/100) × M.P.

⇒4,740 = 79/100 × 60/100 × M.P.

⇒ M.P. = Rs10,000.

Hence, the marked price of an article is Rs10,000.**

questions.question: A dealer purchased a food processor for ₹10,000. He offered a discount of 20% on its listed price and still gained a profit of 40%. Find the listed price of the food processor.
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

CP = 10,000, Discount = 20%, profit = 40%

**To find:-**

Listed price

**Formula used:-** 

Profit %= (SP-CP)/(CP)times 100

**Calculation:-** 

By the formula of profit percentage,

Profit %= (SP-CP)/(CP)times 100 

⇒ 40 = (SP-10,000)/(10,000)times 100

⇒ SP = 4,000 + 10,000

⇒ **SP = Rs.14,000**

Let the marked or listed price be **x**,

By the relation of the listed price, discount, and selling price,

⇒ Listed price(Marked price) - discount = Selling price

⇒ x - 20% of x = 14,000

⇒ x=(14000)/(1-frac{20){100}}

⇒ x = (14000)/(frac{4){5}}

⇒ x = 17,500

**The listed price of the processor is Rs.17500**

questions.question: Find the third proportional to 27 and 18.
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Two proportional numbers are 27, 18

**To find:-**

Third proportional number

**Concept used:-**

Proportionality theorem i.e, a : b :: c : d = (a)/(b)=(c)/(d)

**Calculation:-**

Let the third proportional be x

then by proportionality theorem,

27 : 18 :: 18 : x

⇒(27)/(18)=(18)/(x)

⇒x=(18×18)/(27)

⇒x = 12

**The value of the third proportional is 12.**

questions.question: Raman has a certain average after 9 innings. In the 10th inning he scores 100 runs, thereby increasing his average by 8 runs. His new average is ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:-**Average increased by 8 when 100 runs were added in the 10th inning.

**To find:-**New average

**Concept used:-** Average = (sum of observation)/(Total number observation)

Calculation**:-**Let the initial average be 'x'

Total run scored till 9th inning = 9 × x = 9x

After the 10th inning, the total score will be,

⇒New Total = 9x + 100

⇒New Average = (9x+100)/(10)---------(i)

As the question suggests that the **average is increased by 8**,

⇒New average = x + 8-----------(ii)

By equation (i) and (ii)

⇒(9x+100)/(10) = x + 8

 ⇒9x + 100 = 10x + 80

⇒x = 20

New average = 20 + 8 = 28

**The new average of Raman is 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__

 when innings were 9 the average was x

After the 10th inning the average increased by 8, this means '8' is added to each observation (10 innings)

Basically, 80 runs are extra added to the 9x(initial sum of runs)

This simply means 20 was the old average because if in the 10th inning he had scored 20 runs then the average would've been the same.

⇒20 was the old average and after the 10th inning, it is increased by 8, 

⇒New average = 28

questions.question: If a + b + c = 0,then find the value of frac{{{a²} + {b²} + {c²}}}{{{a²} - bc}}.
questions.solution:
**Given:-

 **a + b + c = 0

**To find:-**

 frac{{{a²} + {b²} + {c²}}}{{{a²} - bc}}

**Formula used:-**

 (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ac

Calculation**:- **

As mentioned, a + b + c = 0

⇒ **a = - b - c**

Let the value of frac{{{a²} + {b²} + {c²}}}{{{a²} - bc}} = k

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 = k(a² - bc)

It is given that a + b + c = 0, On squaring both sides

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ac = 0

Putting, a2 + b2 + c2 = k(a2 - bc)

⇒ k(a2 - bc) + 2ab + 2bc + 2ac = 0

⇒ k(a(- b - c) - bc) + 2ab + 2bc + 2ac =0

⇒ k(- ab - ac - bc) = -2(ab + bc + ac)

⇒ -k(ab + ac + bc) = -2(ab + bc + ac)

By comparing,** k = 2**

**The value of frac{{{a²} + {b²} + {c²}}}{{{a²} - bc}}**** is 2 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

a + b + c = 0 Put the value a = 1, b = 0, c = (-1)

Let the value of frac{{{a²} + {b²} + {c²}}}{{{a²} - bc}} = k 

⇒ [(1)² + 0 + (-1)²]/[(1)2-0 × (-1)] = 2 /1 = 2

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is NOT divisible by 36?

Calculation**:-** Ther number divisible by 6 must be divisible by 36 as 6 is the factor of 36,

Divisibility of 6 :- The number divisible by both 2 and 3 must be divisible by 6 subsequently by 36

⇒The option whose unit digit is even and sum of digit is divisible by 3 must be divisible by 6

Checking **option 1**

136216

questions.question: PQ and RS are two parallel chords of a circle of length 10 cm and 24 cm, respectively, and lie on the same side of the centre O. If the distance between the chords is 7 cm, what is the radius (in cm) of the circle?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

Two chords of length of 10 cm and 24 cm on the same side of center

distance between chords is 7 cm

**To find:** 

Radius of circle

**Concept used:**

Pythagorean theorem

Calculation**:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70512a4b7e141371dea6b286b624456bb0bf61bfced785a451cf72749f30933.png] 

Let A be the point on RS and B be the point on PQ,

⇒ RA =1/2(RS) = 1/2(24) = 12

⇒ PB = 1/2(PQ) = 1/2(10) = 5 

In Δ OAR, ∠ OAR = 90° 

Using the Pythagoras theorem, 

⇒ OR² = OA² + AR²

⇒ r² = OA² + 12²

⇒ r² = OA² + 144 (1)

In Δ OBP, ∠ OBP = 90° 

Using the Pythagoras theorem, 

⇒ OP² = PB² + OB²

⇒ r² = 5² + (OA + 7)²

⇒ r² = 25 + OA² + 49 + 14OA 

⇒ r² = OA² + 14OA + 74 (2)

Equating equations 1 & 2, we get, 

⇒ OA² + 144 = ​OA² + 14OA + 74 

⇒ 70 = 14OA

⇒ OA = 70/14 = 5 

Now, in Δ OAR, 

⇒ OR² = OA² + AR² 

⇒ {r}²={5}²+144

⇒ r² = √169 

⇒Radius = 13 cm

**The radius of the circle is 13 cm**

questions.question: With an average speed of 60 km/h, a train reaches its destination on time. If it goes with an average speed of 45 km/h, it is late by 20 minutes. The distance covered by the train is _____.
questions.solution:
**Given:- **average speed of train = 60km/h

**To find:- **Distance covered by train

**Formula used:- **Distance = speed × time

Calculation:- Let the time taken by train to reach destination be **T** ,

Let the distance travelled by train be **D**

By using the formula, **distance = speed × Time**

when train travels at an average speed of 60 km/h

⇒D = 60 × T ------(i)

when the train travels at an average speed of 45 km/h, takes 20 minutes late,

⇒D = 45 × (T + (20)/(60))

⇒D = 5 × (3T + 1) --------(ii)

Equating (i) and (ii)

⇒ 60 × T = 15 × (3T + 1)

⇒60T = 45T + 15

⇒T = 1 hour

Substituting the value of T in the equation-(i)

⇒D = 60 × T = 60 × 1

⇒D = 60 

**.·.Distance covered by the train is 60km**

questions.question: The surface area of a solid metallic sphere is 616 cm². It is melted and recast into a solid cone of height 28 cm. Find the diameter of the base of the cone so formed. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Surface Area** of **Sphere** = 616 cm² ⇒ 4πr² = 616 ⇒ r = 7 cm.

**Volume** of **Sphere** = **Volume** of **Cone**.

(4/3)πr³ = (1/3)πR²h ⇒ 4 × 7³ = R² × 28.

4 × 343 = R² × 28 ⇒ R² = 1372 / 28 = 49 ⇒ R = 7 cm.

**Diameter** of **Cone** = 2 × R = 2 × 7 = 14 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Surface area of **sphere** = 616 cm², Height of **cone** (h) = 28 cm.

**Formula Used:** Surface Area (Sphere) = 4πr²; Volume (Sphere) = (4/3)πr³; Volume (Cone) = (1/3)πR²h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/538cd4e0b38e93bb04ea1a8a12253e2400b00bc43ab6cbe9cb696d939816b6ee.png] 

**Step 1: Find radius of the sphere (r)**

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r² = 616

⇒ r² = (616 × 7) / (4 × 22) = 616 × 7 / 88

⇒ r² = 7 × 7 = 49 ⇒ r = 7 cm

**Step 2: Equate volumes to find radius of cone (R)**

⇒ (4/3) × π × (7)³ = (1/3) × π × R² × 28

⇒ 4 × 343 = R² × 28

⇒ R² = (4 × 343) / 28 = 343 / 7 = 49

⇒ R = 7 cm

**Step 3: Calculate diameter of the cone**

⇒ Diameter = 2 × R = 2 × 7 = 14 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 14 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Recasting Rule

When one solid is melted and recast into another, the **Volume** remains constant regardless of shape change.

Sphere Properties

Volume = (4/3)πr³ and Total Surface Area = 4πr². For a hemisphere, TSA = 3πr².

Cone Properties

Volume = (1/3)πR²h and Slant Height (l) = √(R² + h²).</p

questions.question: The area of a square is 4x2 - 12x + 9. Which of the following will be the side of the square?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **Equation of square, 4x2 - 12x + 9

**To find:-** Side of the square

**Calculation:-** The given equation is, 4x2 - 12x + 9

Using mid-term split method to find the factors of the equation,

Since, the above equation is of the square then it **must have two same factors** and the** factor will represent its side**

⇒4x2 - 12x + 9 

⇒4x2 - (6 + 6)x + 9 

⇒4x2 - 6x - 6x + 9

⇒2x(2x - 3) - 3(2x -3)

⇒(2x - 3)(2x - 3)

⇒(2x - 3)²

**The side of square is (2x-3)**

questions.question: In one-sixth of the time that B takes to complete a piece of work, A can complete half of the same work. If working together they take 16 days to complete the work, how much time shall B take to complete it alone?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A and B together complete work in = 16 days

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work / No. of days.

**CALCULATION:**

B × 1/2 = A × 1/6 

⇒ A = 3B 

⇒ Aover B = 3 over1 

⇒A's efficiency = 3 unit /day

and B's efficiency = 1 unit/day

⇒ According, to the Question

( A+ B) complete in 16 days

⇒ Total work = ( 3+1) × 16 = 4 × 16 = 64.

⇒ Time taken by B = 64over 1 = 64 days 

**Hence, B alone takes 64 days to complete the work.**
